name: DiscoveryWorld
description: DiscoveryWorld is a virtual interactive environment designed specifically for developing and evaluating automated scientific discovery agents. It features 120 distinct challenge tasks spanning eight different scientific topic areas, requiring agents to formulate hypotheses, design experiments, and analyze results. The environment serves as a dynamic, interactive platform that tests scientific reasoning and long-horizon planning rather than static question answering.
reputation: Recognized as a rigorous environment for scientific discovery evaluation; cited alongside WebArena as an exemplar of dynamic interactive platforms for LLM agents.
notes: 120 tasks across 8 scientific domains. Focuses on higher-order cognitive skills including hypothesis generation, experimental design, and result analysis. Not a static QA dataset but a dynamic interactive environment.
